title: How to build a personal AI assistant that actually understands you

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Did you know your phone already learns your habits?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: AI assistants are getting smarter — and more personal than ever.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It’s a custom AI that adapts to your voice, tone, and even your schedule.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The latest models use emotional recognition from your speech patterns.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This affects millions who rely on AI for work, health, and daily tasks.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The key is training it with your own data — not just generic info.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Want to build one that *really* knows you? Let’s talk.

caption_text: How to build a personal AI assistant that actually understands you
